text:
anna_sales: quick ping — DataGrid wants an on‑prem POC starting 2026-05. Customer is asking to remove the 1-month platform fee for the POC and only pay for support hours. also requires KMS integration and an abbreviated security questionnaire. can we get a deal desk exception?

priya_solutions: do we have rough numbers on expected GPU hours + support? if it's small we could do a credit instead of waiving fee.

marco_eng: estimate: 2x A100s for 4 weeks ~ ~560 GPU hours. infra + SE time ~ 40h (setup + smoke + KMS). risk: KMS + air-gapped networking adds ~1 extra week.

ben_deals: need to know ARR/commit signal to consider platform fee waiver. POCs without any commit normally get a standard POC SKU with 50% platform fee credit, not full waiver. if they can commit to a pilot within 90d (min $Xk MRR), we can escalate full waiver.

tara_finance: can you confirm the exact platform fee line item they want waived? our rate card shows "VPC Platform Fee (monthly)" at $12,000 for this configuration. discounting that to 0 is unusual.

anna_sales: they explicitly asked for waiver during the 30d POC window. customer argument: fintech proof-of-concept will lead to multi-region rollout. they have security concerns about sending logs to hosted control plane — prefer private control plane.

leo_legal: if we waive fees we need an amendment to the SOW with clear end-date and rollback terms. also KMS/HSM integration requires an addendum covering key handling & liability. will need customer sign-off on SOC2 terms + export control checklist.

priya_solutions: alternative proposal to speed closure: offer a 75% platform-fee credit for 30 days (applied as invoice credit) + POC-lite support (email + 8h/week SE) and standard KMS integration (no custom HSM work). customer picks up any remediation work.

raj_customer: confirming from our side — we can accept a credit if it’s documented. timeline: aiming to start 2026-05-10. KMS must be reachable from our VPC and keys managed by our KMS. we can sign the amendment quickly.

ben_deals: ok — option A: 75% credit for 30d + POC-lite, no commit required. Option B: full waiver for 30d if customer signs a 6mo pilot commitment (revenue threshold: $75k). need approval from revenue ops for Option A since it's a deviation on the rate card.

tara_finance: runbook: for Option A we'll issue a contra revenue credit line and require a POC acceptance form. finance needs the signed amendment before booking.

marco_eng: tech note: if we do POC-lite + KMS, ops team will need network runbook and a short window for firewall rules. I'll allocate the 40h but need confirmation on dates.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: new ticket created -> #VPC-POC-2357 assigned to eng-infra, ETA: 2026-05-05. https://tickets.internal/2357

anna_sales: next step: ben — can you take Option A to revenue ops and get a 72h turn? if approved I'll send the amendment draft to the customer today.

ben_deals: will do. tagging @tara_finance & @leo_legal to prep amendment template. i’ll update this thread with revenue ops response within 48-72h. :thumbsup: 

priya_solutions: also adding a short checklist for SE handoff: firewall ranges, KMS endpoint, expected token retention policy, and acceptance criteria (latency <150ms p95 for pilot).

raj_customer: thanks — we'll prepare the security contact and KMS info. appreciate the quick cadence.

anna_sales: thanks everyone. looping back once ben confirms deal desk.

ben_deals: update: revenue ops flagged this as "minor rate card deviation". approving Option A with a cap: credit max $9,000. approval email queued, need signed amendment before credit is applied.

anna_sales: perfect — I'll send amendment and POC acceptance form now.

leo_legal: once signed, legal will issue the KMS addendum and SOW amendment.

priya_solutions: copying in the SE schedule. I'll prepare the onboarding checklist and a short-run playbook for their team.

raj_customer: amendment on the way from our side, expect signed copy within 24h.

anna_sales: awesome — closing loop here. :rocket:
